verdict: Micron's revenue nearly tripled in a year to $23.9B as AI data centers bid memory prices sky-high — 74 cents of every sales dollar survived as gross profit, and net income hit $13.8B.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — the AI memory supercycle

segments.name: Cloud Memory
segments.note: High-bandwidth memory (HBM) stacked right beside AI processors in cloud servers — the scarcest, most valuable memory Micron makes, at a 74% gross margin this quarter.

segments.name: Core Data Center
segments.note: DRAM and NAND for conventional cloud and enterprise data-center servers — revenue more than tripled in a year.

segments.name: Mobile and Client
segments.note: Memory for smartphones, PCs and other consumer devices — a 79% gross margin this quarter as shortage pricing kicked in.

segments.name: Automotive and Embedded
segments.note: Memory for cars, factories and industrial equipment — smaller and steadier than the AI-driven units.

segments.name: All other
segments.note: Small leftovers outside the four business units.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of DRAM, HBM and NAND memory.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams and the cost of running the company.

takeaways.title: Revenue nearly tripled
takeaways.text: Sales rose from $8.1B a year ago to $23.9B — and Micron guided the next quarter to $33.5B, another huge step up.

takeaways.title: Margins exploded
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 74%, double the 37% of a year ago — with supply this tight, price increases fall almost straight through to profit.

takeaways.title: A record profit quarter
takeaways.text: Net income of $13.8B in a single quarter — more than Micron earned in most full years before the AI boom. Non-GAAP net income was $14.0B.

otherDetail: Interest income of $155M on Micron's growing cash pile, less $32M of interest expense, $98M of other non-operating losses and a $4M loss from equity-method investments — a net +$21M.
footerNote: Business-unit revenues are as reported by Micron; 'All other' is the small residual outside the four units.
